items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: They had a manager by the name of Sam Flashnik

ctx.x: At the time you joined the band, they had their own railroad car for traveling, didn't they?

They had a very good setup that way. They had a manager by the name of Sam Flashnik, and, of course, Irving Mills was the impresario. And we would have, if it was a daytime trip, we would have a private coach, a parlor car usually they would call them. And our car would be attached either to the very front of the car section, or the very back. So that the general public didn't go through our car very much. Now, at night we would have two sleeping cars, a dining car, and a baggage car. That was our section of the…
You had your own dining car too?
